summary: 周日晚 Ethlabs 发表长文，逐项给出对 Hegotá 提案的看法：EIP-8141 frame 交易、EIP-8250 keyed nonce、EIP-8272 recent root 都列为 A 级，理由是它们让隐私协议无需中心化 relayer、经公共内存池发送私密交易。kassandra 呼应：FOCIL 已是头条，frame 交易应当加入。nero_eth 说明 66 个提案将在接下来几次核心开发者会议上缩减。Vitalik 谈以太坊扩容策略同时兼顾 UTXO 式状态和动态状态。

summary_en: On Sunday night Ethlabs published a long piece rating each Hegotá proposal: EIP-8141 frame transactions, EIP-8250 keyed nonces and EIP-8272 recent roots are all A-tier, because together they let privacy protocols send private transactions through the public mempool without centralized relayers. kassandra echoed it: FOCIL is already the headliner and frame transactions should join it. nero_eth explained that the 66 proposals will be cut down over the next few core dev calls. Vitalik described Ethereum's scaling strategy as combining UTXO-style state with dynamic state.
